rules.locked: VERIFIED plus immutable lock tag lock/<id>-v1 and file hashes recorded. No current entry is locked.
rules.unknown: All unproven entries remain UNVERIFIED; no guessed test mappings count as evidence.
rules.flags: RECOVERY_ENABLED=false; live collection OFF; automatic settlement/refunds OFF; cloud sync OFF; uiCutover=false.
